formal_scope: Both implications are formalized in two Lean projects. The Lean 4.35 project states the conjecture for every finite Artin–Schreier tower over a base whose valuation ring is henselian in Mathlib's sense, with depth one defined as the least length of a complete Mac Lane–Vaquié chain over all primitive generators; it compares these chains with Okutsu sequences at length one only. The Lean 4.19 project states depth one through Okutsu sequences in the algebraic closure of K inside the Hahn field.
